# TASK-166 — One idea in, draft out

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Minimal path to a correct specification (2026-10-07)

## Intent

The idea is the "What are you building?" sentence. It becomes the description, and one AI run (through the same checks as any run: feature switch, local-only rule, budgets, provider) drafts only the essential answers as a proposal, with "unknown" where the sentence says nothing. A refusal comes back as an answer with its reason, never as a failure, and nothing is written directly.

## What it delivers

`api/idea-draft.ts`, `POST /projects/:id/draft`. Verified with a queued run through the fake local model: the prompt names the sentence and exactly the 15 questions, the result is one pending proposal and the specification is untouched; no model, local-only without a local model, a disabled AI feature, viewers and bad input are all answered, not failed. Not verified: the quality of a real model's answers.
